frame: Lander at the origin. east and north are metres at true scale. In Three.js use x = east, y = up, z = -north.

confidence.approximate: Placed by eye or from memory. NOT verified; check before presenting as fact.

facts.roverSize: 65 x 48 x 30 cm, six wheels of 13 cm diameter
facts.roverDistance: about 100 m in total, always within about 12 m of the lander
facts.cameraMast: camera about 1.5 m above the ground on a 0.8 m pop-up mast
facts.landerSize: about 2.75 m across with petals open (approximate, not re-checked)

rocks.label: Yogi
rocks.note: NASA: a metre-size rock about 5 m northwest of the lander. Exact width, height and depth are approximate.

rocks.label: Barnacle Bill
rocks.note: NASA: a small rock immediately west-northwest of the lander. The 2.2 m distance and the size are approximate.

rocks.label: Scooby-Doo
rocks.note: Analysed on sol 14. Its direction and distance from the lander are NOT verified.

rocks.label: Wedge
rocks.note: In the Rock Garden, southwest of the lander. Position and size approximate.

rocks.label: Shark
rocks.note: Reported as about 0.69 m wide, 0.40 m high and 6.4 m from the lander, in the Rock Garden to the southwest. The exact bearing and the depth are approximate.

rocks.label: Half Dome
rocks.note: In the Rock Garden next to Shark. Position and size approximate.

rocks.label: Moe
rocks.note: In the Rock Garden; shows fluting from wind erosion. Position and size approximate.

rocks.label: Stimpy
rocks.note: In front of Moe. Position and size approximate.

rocks.label: Chimp
rocks.note: A tabular rock beyond the Rock Garden; the rover was last seen near it. Position and size approximate.

points.label: Sojourner: last known position
points.note: Near the rock Chimp at the final data transmission on 27 September 1997. Sources give 12 m (Wikipedia: always within 12 m) to 13 m (Astronomy) from the lander. Exact spot approximate.

points.label: Sojourner: possible resting place
points.note: A feature about 6 m due south of the lander in the 21 December 2006 HiRISE image, tentatively identified as the rover. The identification was never confirmed.

distant.label: Twin Peaks
distant.note: Two hills on the southwestern horizon, about 1 to 2 km away. Not modelled.

models.label: Whole landing site
models.note: Lander, named rocks, both Sojourner positions and a random rock field, at true scale. Rock positions marked approximate in layout.json are not verified.
